emails.subject: This week: a Slack worth joining, two conferences, one free workshop
body: Good morning, Tulsa.

1. Techlahoma Slack. Technologists across Oklahoma ask questions, share events and post jobs there. Public channels are part of Techlahoma's free membership. Say hello in #introduce-yourself, ask in #tech-talk, and read the rules before you post in #jobs.
2. ThunderPlains. Techlahoma's annual web and mobile developer conference in Oklahoma City, organized by volunteers.
3. 200OK. Techlahoma's one-day developer conference in Tulsa. The 2027 date is not announced yet; there is an early list.
4. Thursday: Google Dev x Women+ in Tech: Actual Productivity with AI, 6 to 8 PM at Gitwit. Free, no engineering background needed.
No reply needed. See you out there.

emails.subject: Hosting during Tulsa Tech Week: how it works
body: A short explainer for first-time hosts.
Tulsa Tech Week is a week-long series of tech events across Tulsa. Each event is hosted by a different person or organization, so you run your own event and it is listed with the rest.
In its first year, 2025, more than 80 partners hosted free events.
Nothing to do yet. No reply needed.
